description:
Split trip costs fairly: per leg, not flat. Offline, no account needed. Those who ride along pay along. Those who don't, don't. RapidSplit settles kayak, club and group trips fairly: leg by leg instead of flat rates. 🛶 PER-LEG TRAVEL COSTS Set up your trip as legs (e.g. outbound, shuttle, return) and mark who rode along on each leg. Only those people share that leg's costs. Settle via a per-km rate or by fuel costs split by kilometre share. 💶 EVERY COST OF THE TRIP
  • Assign driver expenses (tolls, parking, permits) to individual legs
  • Shared expenses like groceries or campsites, with multiple payers if needed
  • Foreign currencies with stored daily rates
  • Optionally combine club or family balances into one group
  • Manage several trips in parallel
✅ A CLEAR RESULT Costs per person, balances and "who pays whom" with the minimum number of transfers. Export as PDF or CSV for records and sharing. 🤝 SETTLE TOGETHER Share your trip via QR code or a 6-digit code and edit it together. For this, an end-to-end encrypted copy is uploaded to the RapidSplit server. You can delete your shared trips from the server at any time. No one except the people you invite has access to the trip data. 🔒 PRIVATE BY DESIGN
  • No account, no registration
  • Works fully offline – ideal in the outdoors
  • Your data stays on your device by default – only what you explicitly share goes to the RapidSplit server
  • No tracking, no ads
  • Free and open source (GPL-3.0)
Includes a step-by-step tutorial and a sample trip to try out. Light and dark mode. 🌍 ENGLISH OR GERMAN The interface comes in both languages – on first launch you pick language, theme and default currency, and you can change all of it later from the menu.
